name: run_dynamo_graph

description.what: Runs a saved Dynamo graph against the open Revit model.
description.when: Use when the user asks to apply a standard process the firm has already scripted — renumbering, tagging, parameter population, export.
description.whenNot: Not for creating a new graph, and not for a graph absent from the catalogue.
requires: A Revit document must be open
description.onPartialSuccess: Returns the count that worked and the list that did not, with reasons. A warnings array is present on partial success — surface it rather than reporting a clean run.

blastRadius: Whatever the graph does to the open model. Bounded by the graph, not by this tool — which is why only catalogued graphs are runnable.
